# Everpaper

> Everpaper is a private memory of your workdays and meetings that runs on your Mac. It keeps a searchable history of what was on your screen and what was said in your calls, and answers questions about it with the exact screenshot or the moment in the recording. Everpaper is in private beta for macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon Macs. Recordings and screenshots never leave the Mac. Text reaches an AI provider only if you connect one that runs off this Mac.

Updated 21 October 2026. The full product facts are in https://everpaper.app/llms-full.txt.
